To thank you for your support for playing our game H-Isekai Loves. So we want to give you a small gift.
Every day, we will give away a certain amount of H-Isekai Loves game keys.
Players who are quick can get the key to access the game or give it to your friends.
So, please check this post every day if you want it.

We're really sorry because our team isn't rich, so here's what we can give you right now. We hope you will continue to support our game from now on.

Please remember, which those keys, you can't review our game. So this is not a tricks to increase our game reviews. We just want you can enjoy our game.

notes.title: UPDATED : BLIND-GEM HAS BEEN REMOVED FROM THE GAME
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40915020/40d7d202f292a67c6b4457e26ea87ef6841b3bfe.jpg[/img]
Hello dear players,

Based on feedback from many players, we decided to remove the Blind Gem from the game, in order to give you a better experience.
We hope this will give you a more comfortable experience while playing our game.

Thank you for your comments and support all the time.
We wish you have a good day ♥♥♥

Gblood team.

<Lucky number>

How to join the event :

1- Each of you, enter a dot in this post. 
2- Each person only enter once.
3- You need to own H-Isekai Loves already.

Event Period: February 13 - February 20, 2022 (PST)
The winner will be announced in the comments of this post.

Thanks and wish you have a good day ♥♥♥

notes.title: The new release date will be moved to January 2022
notes.content:
Recently, we have received many messages from you guys asking about the release date of the game [H-Isekai Loves].  And we are very happy about it.

Sadly, the Covid-19 pandemic has impacted all of us, so we had to pause game development because of the Covid-19 pandemic, as well as some health issues. And now we're going back to game development and trying to speed things up.

Although our team is only 2 members, we will try to do our best. [b]Hopefully we can launch this game in January 2022.[/b]

Once again, thank you very much for your interest in our game. We wish you a lot of health.

Best regards,
Gblood team
